correctness.rationale: The nonzero inner-rank-one matrices partition by common p-adic valuation into primitive outer-product layers of size U_n=p^(3n-3)(p-1)(p+1)^2. Character orthogonality on primitive vectors, followed by Smith reduction B~diag(p^a,p^b), gives the five explicit nonzero local character-sum cases, whose layer sum yields the four-piece lambda_(a,b) formula in RESULT.md. Smith-type multiplicities follow from invertible and primitive rank-one orbit counts and exact determinant valuation differences. All types sum to p^(4k); diagonal a=b<k and off-diagonal a<b<k eigenvalues are negative with magnitudes >=p+1, while b=k types are positive and larger. Equality of abs lambda with p+1 is precisely a=b=0. An independent implementation constructed adjacency sets and full four-dimensional DFT, matching all Fourier multipliers and multiplicities for (p,k)=(2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,2) (77,338 cumulative independent assertions). The all-depth result relies on the proved orthogonality and Smith count, not tests.
